messages:
Natalie - CSM: Quick heads-up — BrightLens dedicated bring-up scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need final sign-off on quotas, autoscale policy, and a short warmup+load run.
Ajay (DevOps): I can own the autoscale policy and trigger the warmup. What's the quota commit they signed?
Natalie - CSM: Committed to 200K tokens/day baseline and 4 reserved GPUs, with burst up to 6 GPUs. They expect production finger on 50 rps peak across generation endpoints.
Maria (Customer Success): They also want embeddings table seeding during bring-up — estimate ~600 reqs/min for the embedding route during the test window.
Liam SRE: Noted. For autoscale, suggest min_replicas=4, max_replicas=8, scale_metric=cpu_utilization, target=65. For GPU-backed workers we'll use node autoscaler + pod HPA on GPU utilization proxy.
Evan (AE): Pinged them to confirm the 09:00 PST window. They're okay with a single 30-minute window for functional + load validation.
Ajay (DevOps): Draft autoscale config below — please review.
Ajay (DevOps): ```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 8
  metrics:
    - type: GPU_UTILIZATION
      target: 65
    - type: QUEUE_LENGTH
      target: 100
  cooldown: 90s
```
Liam SRE: LGTM. Add a fallback rule if GPU util > 90% for 2m -> trigger fallback to hosted shard for non-critical routes.
Natalie - CSM: Good call. We need to document the fallback and runbook in the onboarding checklist and share with BrightLens ops.
Maria (Customer Success): I'll handle the runbook snippet and send to them after the test.
Ajay (DevOps): Load test plan: 10m warmup (steady ramp to target), 30m peak at 120 gen qps, 40 embedding qps, then 10m cooldown. Script uses k6.
Ajay (DevOps): Example k6 command: ```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 50m load/brightlens_test.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```
Evan (AE): They asked for latency SLOs: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 400ms for generation under steady load. Is that realistic?
Liam SRE: p50 is okay, p95 depends on batch sizes and KV cache hit rate. For warm cache expect p95 ~250-350ms. If cache miss heavy, could spike >600ms. We'll monitor KV hit and token batching.
Natalie - CSM: Action items: Ajay to apply autoscale policy + schedule load test, Liam to watch infra and set alerts, Maria to deliver runbook, Evan to confirm customer ready.
Ajay (DevOps): I'll schedule the k6 job and tag the run with brightlens-0900. Will also kick a small smoke deploy 30m before.
deploy-bot: deployment brightlens-dedicated/v3.2 started by Ajay (DevOps) at 1769427000
Liam SRE: Dashboard panels to watch: GPU util, pod restart rate, request queue length, KV cache hit rate, p50/p95 generation latency, embedding throughput. I'll pin a dashboard and share link right after deploy.
Maria (Customer Success): FYI flagged renewal risk: if performance doesn't meet SLOs during this bring-up, BrightLens will ask for credits. We should have communication templates ready.
Natalie - CSM: Understood. Prepare template: summary of findings, mitigation plan, follow-up run offer. Keep it ready.
Ajay (DevOps): During the test, if GPU util > 85% and p95 > 500ms, we'll reduce batch_size from 8 -> 4 and enable mixed-quantization variant. Command to toggle: `redwood api model-variant set --project brightlens --variant mixed-quant --route /generate`.
Evan (AE): I'll be on the call with BrightLens during the run to capture reactions and immediate feedback.
Liam SRE: After the 30m peak, we'll run a 10m soak at 25% traffic to validate cache retention and warmup. Also capture heap/GC stats for the runtime.
Maria (Customer Success): Can someone confirm we have quota reservations applied in the control plane? Last time it needed a manual uplift.
Ajay (DevOps): Checking... I see reservation ID res-9821 for brightlens, 4 GPUs reserved active. I will attach the reservation to the cluster tomorrow before 08:40 PST.
Natalie - CSM: Perfect. Final checklist item: share runbook + dashboard link + escalation numbers by EOD today.
Maria (Customer Success): Working on runbook, will drop in thread when done. :white_check_mark:
Ajay (DevOps): Scheduling note: I'll run a small canary 3 times in the hour before main test. If all green, proceed.
Liam SRE: I'll add short-term alert thresholds and set a PagerDuty override for the window.
Natalie - CSM: Thanks all. We'll sync 08:30 PST for pre-checks.
Evan (AE): BrightLens confirmed. See you on the call. :thumbsup:
